testCases.title: Apply Filter to View Items from Selected Category
steps: Select a valid category from the filter options.
expectedResults: Items from the selected category are displayed.

testCases.title: Attempt to Filter with a Non-Existent Category
steps: Select a non-existent category from the filter options.
expectedResults: An appropriate message is displayed indicating the category does not exist.

testCases.title: Reset Filter to View All Items
steps: Apply a filter using a valid category.
